text: 我40岁，俩宝宝妈妈。
en: I am 40 years old, a mother of two children.

text: 平淡生活，但体会很多，真的。
en: A plain, uneventful life, but I have felt a great deal, truly.

text: 大概的说几点吧。
en: Let me roughly mention a few points.

text: 心累，是首位。
en: Mental exhaustion comes first.

text: 老大初中，叛逆，以前是乖乖女，虽然也不算很乖，但是，那会还讲道理，讲道理有用。
en: My eldest is in junior secondary school and is rebellious. She used to be a well-behaved girl, though not especially good, but back then you could reason with her, and reasoning worked.

text: 目前，初二，讲道理已经没用，天天手机不离手，我很无力，管不住，母女俩已经到了不说话的地步了。
en: Now, in her second year of junior secondary, reasoning no longer works. She is on her phone all day long. I feel helpless, unable to control her, and the two of us, mother and daughter, have reached the point of not speaking to each other.

text: 还有，就是老公，有时候特别心累的时候想给他吐槽下，但是，吐槽完毕你会发现，还不如闭嘴。
en: Then there is my husband. Sometimes, when I am utterly drained, I want to offload to him, but once I have finished venting, you find it would have been better to keep quiet.

text: 还有老二，精力旺盛，晚上不睡，熬人。
en: Then there is the younger one, full of energy, refusing to sleep at night, absolutely exhausting.

text: 40岁，我的体力跟不上。
en: At 40, my physical strength cannot keep up.

text: 再有重要的一点，经济压力大，但是，无能为力。
en: Another important point: the financial pressure is great, but there is nothing I can do about it.

text: 事实上，这才是最最重要的吧！
en: In fact, this is the most important thing of all!

text: 毕竟，经济是精神的基础嘛！
en: After all, the economy is the foundation of the spirit!

text: 在此还是希望，所有的中年人，都力争幸福！
en: Here I still hope that all middle-aged people strive for happiness!

text: 1、夫妻感情不睦
en: 1. Discord between husband and wife

text: 人到中年后，往往很多夫妻之间都在一起生活了很多年，所谓的爱情就像是一件掉色的衣服，在这些年的生活洗礼
en: After people reach middle age, many couples have often lived together for many years; so-called love is like a faded garment that, through the baptism of these years of life,

text: 下，逐渐褪去了光鲜的色彩，只剩下了原始的一片空白。
en: has gradually lost its bright colours, leaving only a primal blankness.

text: 平淡就是婚姻的坟墓，平淡的生活怎能抵得过狂野内心的不安。
en: Monotony is the grave of marriage; how can a dull life withstand the restlessness of a wild heart.

text: 味同嚼蜡 的生活，让很多夫妻之间将原本不起眼的问题放大，继而进入了所谓的七年之痒 、十年之痒。
en: A life as tasteless as chewing wax makes many couples magnify originally insignificant problems, and then enter the so-called seven-year itch, ten-year itch.

text: 原本应该是最亲密的两个人，却时常会因为各种小事争吵个不休，家也不再是大家的避风港 ，而是迫不及待想要逃离
en: The two people who should be closest instead often quarrel endlessly over trivial matters; home is no longer everyone's haven, but rather something they cannot wait to flee from,

text: 的“地狱”。
en: a 'hell'.

text: 虽然看似生活和工作是分开单独的两个部分，但实际上两者是息息相关的，往往一个人生活不快，工作也会跟着不
en: Although life and work may seem like two separate parts, in reality the two are closely linked; often when a person is unhappy in life, work also becomes

text: 顺，整个人也会陷入焦虑、烦躁的情绪中。
en: unsmooth, and the whole person sinks into anxiety and irritability.

text: 2、孩子的叛逆不懂事
en: 2. The child's rebelliousness and immaturity

text: 现在的孩子越来越难管束，他们总是在倡导着自我、自由，时刻都想摆脱父母的管束，尤其是在进入青春期后。
en: Children nowadays are harder and harder to discipline; they are always asserting the self and freedom, wanting to shake off their parents' control at every moment, especially after entering puberty.

text: 似乎位于这个阶段的孩子，不论父母做什么都不对，他们都要对着干，你让他往东，他偏要往西。
en: It seems that children at this stage oppose whatever their parents do; tell them to go east and they insist on going west.

text: 对于家长来说，都希望自己的孩子能有个美好的未来，起码不能走上歪路，但又不敢管的太过严厉。
en: As for parents, all hope their children will have a bright future and at least not go down the wrong path, yet they dare not be too strict.

text: 因为从各大新闻媒体 上都能看到，时常会有青春期的孩子，在和父母之间发生矛盾后就走了极端。
en: Because on all the major news media one can see that there are often adolescents who take extreme action after falling into conflict with their parents.

text: 和其他的一切对比，只要孩子能够好好的活着就行，什么学习、什么成绩这些都不再重要。
en: Compared with everything else, as long as the child is alive and well, nothing else, studies or grades, matters any more.

text: 平时在家里，父母和孩子尽量保持一种平等的地位，遇事要征求孩子的意见。
en: At ordinary times at home, parents and children should try to maintain an equal footing, and consult the child's opinion when matters arise.

text: 这话看似没错，但实际做起来却困难重重，因为很多时候孩子的意见是不正确的，或者是和父母的想法完全相悖。
en: This sounds right, but in practice it is fraught with difficulty, because much of the time the child's opinion is wrong, or completely contrary to the parents' thinking.

text: 如果尊重孩子的意见，不仅可能需要面临各种负面影响，甚至还可能就此让孩子养成过于自我 的性格。
en: If you respect the child's opinion, you may not only face various negative consequences, but may even cause the child to develop an overly self-centred character.

text: 如果不尊重孩子的意见，会让孩子觉得家长不过是在走形式而已，容易失去对家长的信任。
en: If you do not respect the child's opinion, the child will feel the parent is merely going through the motions, and easily lose trust in the parent.

text: 而如果想要通过谆谆诱导，让孩子认可自己的观点，对于青春期的孩子来说，实在是太困难了。
en: And if you wish to guide the child patiently so they accept your views, it is far too difficult for an adolescent.

text: 因为此时的他们更多时候并不在意什么对错，他们在乎的是自己的选择权，以及父母给予的尊重和自由。
en: Because at this time they care, more often than not, not about right and wrong, but about their own right to choose, and the respect and freedom their parents give them.

text: 3、遇上了今生挚爱
en: 3. Meeting the great love of one's life

text: 很多时候人们之所以会喜欢玫瑰，并非是因为在看过繁花三千 后，才发现玫瑰是自己的挚爱，而是他自始至终都只看
en: Much of the time, the reason people like the rose is not that, having seen three thousand blossoms, they discover the rose is their true love, but that from beginning to end they have only ever looked at

text: 过玫瑰。
en: the rose.

text: 所以当有一天他遇见淡雅清香的百合时，就可能会为之倾倒，发现玫瑰也不过尔尔。
en: So when one day he meets the elegant, faintly fragrant lily, he may be captivated by it and find that the rose is, after all, nothing special.

text: 如果还是独身，遇到这类问题自然是好解决的，但对于中年人来说，在已有家世的情况下，他们肩上所扛着的不是只
en: If one is still single, such a problem is naturally easy to resolve; but for middle-aged people, who already have a family, what they carry on their shoulders is not merely

text: 有自己的喜怒哀乐 而已，还有家人。
en: their own joys and sorrows, but also their family.

text: 如何和爱人选择分开，势必会伤害对方，毕竟在过往的岁月中，彼此之间也曾有过炽烈美好的爱恋。
en: Choosing to part from one's lover is bound to hurt the other, for in the years gone by the two of you once shared a passionate and beautiful love.

text: 同时，自己这样的行为势必也会伤害孩子，相较于爱人而言，孩子才会是大家最无法割舍和不忍的。
en: At the same time, such behaviour of yours is bound to hurt the child as well; compared with the lover, the child is what no one can bear to give up or part with.

text: 而如果为了顾全大局，选择放弃今生挚爱，自己心中的痛和遗憾，将会成为日后永远无法愈合的伤口。
en: Yet if, for the sake of the greater good, you choose to give up the great love of this life, the pain and regret in your heart will become a wound that can never be healed.

text: 个人随笔，喜欢研究人情世故、潜规则，发家致富，创业营销，私人号：1577-6829-17（纯数字），我每天也会更新很多这方面的内容，添加备注123即送《人情世故108招》《人性潜规则》《一语道破中国千年潜规则》
en: Personal essay. I enjoy studying social niceties, unspoken rules, getting rich, entrepreneurship and marketing. Private account: 1577-6829-17 (digits only). I also update a great deal of content on this every day; add the note '123' and I will give you '108 Ways of Social Savvy', 'The Unspoken Rules of Human Nature', and 'Seeing Through China's Millennia of Unspoken Rules'.

text: 喜欢就点个赞吧，感谢大家支持！
en: If you like it, please give it a like, and thank you all for your support!

text: 1.每天都感到焦虑，压力山大，但偶尔又觉得自己算幸运儿，无病无灾家人齐整。
en: 1. Every day I feel anxious, under enormous pressure, but occasionally I feel I am fortunate, free of illness and disaster, with my family intact.

text: 2.夫妻之间的感情已是凑凑合合地过，孩子，老人，家庭事情是二人能交流的话题；
en: 2. The affection between husband and wife is merely muddling along; children, elderly parents and family matters are the only topics the two of them can talk about;

text: 3.不知不觉发现自己的父母已是多病多痛的老人，常跑医院会觉得恼火，但又怕父母的离开更靠死亡。
en: 3. Before I knew it, I found my own parents had become ailing, pain-ridden old people. Running to hospital often makes me furious, yet I also fear their departure, which draws closer to death.

text: 如果父母已不在又觉得人生不美满，内疚常上心头。
en: If one's parents are already gone, one feels life is unfulfilled, and guilt often weighs on the heart.

text: 4.看着年轻人在工作突飞猛进日进斗金，羡慕他们的勇敢，又骂自己平庸没法达到财务自由。
en: 4. Watching young people surge ahead at work and earn a fortune daily, I envy their courage, yet scold myself for being mediocre and unable to achieve financial freedom.

text: 5.孩子是眼看着一天天的长大，读书如何，就业如何，结婚如何，都在这几个阶段中过渡着，操心着；
en: 5. The children are watched as they grow day by day; how they study, find employment, marry, all pass through these stages, and one worries about them;

text: 6.人到中年发现已没有太大的发展，对任何事物都认软了，没有当初的棱角与峰芒。
en: 6. Reaching middle age, one finds there is no great further development; one has grown submissive towards everything, having lost the edges and sharpness of younger days.

text: 一：大龄剩女很纠结，人这一辈子到底为什么而活？
en: One: The older single woman is deeply conflicted, what on earth are we living this life for?

text: 当我看到这条火爆的动画短片，引发了无数人对人生意义的思考。
en: When I saw this wildly popular animated short film, it sparked countless people's reflection on the meaning of life.

text: 这只名叫杰瑞的小老鼠不远万里，从家乡来到了大城市。
en: This little mouse named Jerry travelled far from his hometown to the big city.

text: 它用尽全力地往前跑，却发现这里有成千上万只，和它一样的老鼠目光发呆。
en: He ran forward with all his might, only to find that here there were thousands upon thousands of mice just like him, staring blankly.

text: 但是，面无表情，大家在熙熙冉冉的鼠群中排着队。
en: But, expressionless, everyone queued in the bustling throng of mice.

text: 等待着那辆通往幸福的列车，杰瑞深知只要自己能上车，就会离幸福更近一点。
en: Waiting for the train bound for happiness, Jerry knew well that as long as he could get on board, he would be a little closer to happiness.

text: 哪怕可能会牺牲掉自己的尾巴，它也要用力挤上去。
en: Even if it might cost him his tail, he would push his way on.

text: 杰瑞上车了，它顺利来到下一站，没想到这里的一切让它更加眼花缭乱。
en: Jerry got on the train and smoothly arrived at the next station, never expecting that everything here would dazzle him even more.

text: 拥堵的商场，密集的人群，嘈杂的声音。
en: Crowded shopping malls, dense crowds, cacophonous noise.

text: 在各种售卖幸福的地方，大家都在为了抢夺资源而厮杀着。
en: In all the places that sell happiness, everyone is fighting tooth and nail to seize resources.

text: 遍体鳞伤的杰瑞，从商场出来后，偶然坐上了一辆红色的跑车。
en: Battered and bruised, Jerry came out of the mall and by chance got into a red sports car.

text: 一路驰骋在路上，它觉得这就是自己想要的幸福。
en: Speeding along the road, he felt this was the happiness he wanted.

text: 但很快幸福消失了，贴罚单，偷车轮还被恶搞。
en: But soon the happiness vanished, a parking ticket, his wheels stolen, and he was even pranked.

text: 让杰瑞沮丧无比，它尝试过用酒精麻醉自己。
en: It left Jerry utterly dejected; he tried to numb himself with alcohol.

text: 但酒醒后又会变得迷茫起来。
en: But after sobering up he would become lost again.

text: 这时它看到一张有幸福药丸的宣传单，找到了这种药丸，它毫不犹豫地吃了下去，很快地它来到了一个无忧无虑的世界。
en: Then he saw a flyer for happiness pills, found the pills, and without hesitation swallowed one; soon he arrived in a carefree world.

text: 快乐地飞翔着，然而这终究只是幻想。
en: He flew about joyfully, yet in the end it was only a fantasy.

text: 药效过后，杰瑞再次被狠狠地打回了原形。
en: When the drug wore off, Jerry was once again brutally knocked back to his original state.

text: 回到现实生活中的它，又一次闻到了幸福的味道。
en: Back in real life, he caught the scent of happiness once more.

text: 原来是一张钞票，它一路追着跑。
en: It turned out to be a banknote, and he chased after it all the way.

text: 跑了好远，好多地方，终于抓住了这张钞票。
en: He ran far, through many places, and finally caught the banknote.

text: 但就在那一瞬间，它被一个巨大的老鼠夹夹住了，和其它千千万万的同类一样。
en: But in that very instant, he was caught by a giant mousetrap, just like thousands upon thousands of his kind.

text: 杰瑞也成为一台工作机器，被永远禁雇在那里，这条短片的名字叫作《幸福》。
en: Jerry too became a working machine, permanently employed there, and the short film is titled 'Happiness'.

text: 二：大龄剩女选择喜欢的生活方式，只要不后悔，那也是别样的幸福。
en: Two: The older single woman chooses a lifestyle she likes; as long as she has no regrets, that too is a different kind of happiness.

text: 很多人看后都深受触动，在生活中打拼的我们，又何尝不是这样呢？
en: Many people were deeply moved after watching it; aren't we, who struggle in life, exactly the same?

text: 在不停地追寻幸福的同时，却又不知道幸福是什么？
en: While ceaselessly pursuing happiness, we do not know what happiness is?

text: 很累，很迷茫。
en: Very tired, very lost.

text: 都以为结婚就是幸福的归宿，可为何已经步入大龄剩女的行列，我却还是单身一人？
en: We all think marriage is the destination of happiness, yet why, having already joined the ranks of older single women, am I still alone?

text: 不知道自己为什么而累，喧闹过后，感觉更加空虚和孤独。
en: Not knowing why I am weary, after the noise dies down I feel even more empty and lonely.

text: 厌倦每天重复的3点1线，却又无力挣脱。
en: Weary of the repetitive three-points-and-a-line of every day, yet powerless to break free.

text: 如果一个人知道为什么而活，就能够忍受任何一种生活，那么人到底为什么而活呢？
en: If a person knows why they live, they can endure any kind of life, so why on earth do people live?

text: 是为了金钱，爱情或事业吗？
en: Is it for money, love or career?

text: 其实，这没有唯一的标准，每个人的一生都在不断地寻找自己的答案。
en: In truth there is no single standard; each person spends their whole life continually searching for their own answer.

text: 如果人16岁，就清楚知道自己想要什么？
en: What if a person at 16 already clearly knows what they want?

text: 但在26岁改变了想法，有的人认为拼命工作才有意义。
en: But at 26 they change their mind; some believe only working desperately has meaning.

text: 有的人觉得躺平的人生最幸福，有的人觉得结婚生子才是人生圆满。
en: Some feel a lying-flat life is happiest; some feel that marrying and having children is the fulfilment of life.

text: 有的人觉得一个人也可以活得很快乐，有的人拥有了很却失去了快乐的能力。
en: Some feel a person can live very happily alone; some have gained much yet lost the ability to be happy.

text: 也有的人即便一无所有，也可以每天都过得很开心。
en: And there are those who, even with nothing at all, can be very happy every day.

text: 不管哪一种人生，只要是自己选择的。
en: Whichever kind of life it is, so long as it is one's own choice.

text: 不管是快乐还是痛苦，都有其存在的意义。
en: Whether happy or painful, it has meaning in its existence.

text: 但可以肯定的是，我们活着不是为了成为金钱事业，等等任何事物的奴隶。
en: But what is certain is that we do not live to become slaves to money, career, or any such thing.

text: 努力不是为了成为别人眼中的偶像，而是为了找到自己，成为更好的自己。
en: Effort is not to become an idol in others' eyes, but to find oneself and become a better self.

text: 不是每一件算得出来的事都有意义，也不是每件有意义的事都能被算出来。
en: Not everything that can be measured has meaning, nor can everything meaningful be measured.

text: 每个人都有着属于自己的人生，始终能创造属于自己的命运。
en: Each person has a life of their own, and can always create a destiny of their own.

text: 当你去做一件自己喜欢的，你认为有意义的事情并享受其中。
en: When you do something you like, that you consider meaningful, and take enjoyment in it,

text: 自然而然的你就能够收获到，充足的意义和满足感。
en: naturally you will harvest ample meaning and a sense of fulfilment.

text: 就像当你是一个，在吃蛋糕时好好享用它的每一口。
en: It is like being someone who, when eating a cake, savours every bite of it.

text: 不必去担心几口要被吃完，也不必焦虑吃这块蛋糕有什么用处。
en: You need not worry about how many bites are left, nor anxiously wonder what use eating this cake serves.

text: 只是活在当下，或许这也是活着的意义。
en: Simply live in the present; perhaps that too is the meaning of living.

text: 三：大龄剩女结婚要找喜欢的，还是合适的？
en: Three: Should the older single woman marry for someone she likes, or someone suitable?

text: 我一直强调，要跟非常喜欢的人结婚。
en: I have always stressed: marry someone you like very much.

text: 有些人反驳我说这样不行，那我问你，如果你不喜欢他。
en: Some retort that this will not do; so let me ask you: if you do not like him,

text: 他背叛你就可以吗？
en: is it all right for him to betray you?

text: 你还是会难过，愤怒屈辱也会爆发。
en: You would still be sad, and anger and humiliation would erupt.

text: 所有的负面情绪不是这样吗？
en: Are not all negative emotions like this?

text: 这是很现实的问题，所以我想告诉大家一个真相。
en: This is a very real problem, so I want to tell everyone a truth.

text: 这个世界上没有绝对合适的两个人，难道各方面天作之合就算合适吗？
en: There are no two absolutely compatible people in this world; does a match made in heaven in every respect count as compatible?

text: 但这样的人几乎不存在合适，说白了就是对彼此缺点的忍耐力。
en: But such people barely exist, compatibility, plainly put, is the tolerance for each other's flaws.

text: 如果你漂亮聪明能干，谁都会喜欢你的优点和闪光点。
en: If you are beautiful, clever and capable, everyone will like your strengths and shining points.

text: 问题是你的缺点，谁能忍？
en: The question is your shortcomings, who can tolerate them?

text: 这才是问题的关键。
en: This is the crux of the matter.

text: 那么我想告诉你，只有喜欢你，爱你的人才能忍。
en: So I want to tell you: only those who like you, who love you, can tolerate them.

text: 所以他才可能是合适的人，相反的你能包容一个你不喜欢的人的所有的缺点吗？
en: So he may be the suitable one; conversely, could you tolerate all the flaws of someone you do not like?

text: 说实话很难，一个你喜欢的人唱歌跑调，你都会说真好听我喜欢。
en: To be honest it is hard; a person you like sings off-key, and you will say it sounds lovely, I like it.

text: 唱的很好听，如果你不喜欢他，那你恨不得他闭嘴，对吗？
en: Sings very nicely, but if you do not like him, you would wish he would just shut up, would you not?

text: 所以，我还是那句话，没有单纯的合不合适，喜欢你才有可能合适。
en: So, as I have said all along, there is no such thing as simply compatible or not; only if they like you is compatibility possible.
